label: 6. There are all sorts of interesting things in t…

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: There are all sorts of interesting things in the ocean up here.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: I was glancing out at the water,

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: and saw a fish with wings flying around!
That was probably a flying fish.
Really?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: A flying fish?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Wow, it even advertises the fact that it can fly in the name!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: I thought it was a bird at first,

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: but when I looked closer, it actually was a fish.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: I thought creatures like that only existed in video games.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: I was totally shocked

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: to discover that such things exist in real life!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Hold on!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Does that mean

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: dragons could exist somewhere on the surface too?
That may be a bit of a stretch.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Then how about unicorns?
Probably not.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Then surely there must be a mouse that shoots electricity?
Doubt it, but there is a fish that shoots electricity.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: For real?!
It's called an electric eel.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Electric eel.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Even the name is cool!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: First fish that fly,

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: and now fish that fire electricity.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: The ocean is really a cool place!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: It's like a dungeon in a video game.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: All right, no time to waste.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: We've gotta gear up right away

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: and head out to find an electric eel!
We can't do that.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Why not?
They live in rivers.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Not in the ocean?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Whyyyyyy?!
I don't know. They just evolved that way?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Darn it!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: I wanted to see a fish

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: that shoots electricity!
Sorry to disappoint you.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: Still, who's to say there aren't electrified fish living somewhere in the ocean?

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: It's a big place, after all.

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: One of these days, I'll find one!

lines.speaker: elegg_s
lines.text: And when I do, I'll tell you!
